stories.headline: Bristol-Myers Squibb Reaffirms FY26 Outlook - Update
stories.body: (RTTNews) - While reporting financial results for the first quarter on Thursday, Bristol-Myers Squibb Co. (BMY) reaffirmed its adjusted earnings and revenue growth guidance for the full-year 2026.

stories.headline: A volatile Japanese yen poses real risks for US banks' funding
stories.body: The Japan-linked risk for banks is not the exchange rate itself but the funding, collateral and rollover pressure behind it. Sudden volatility in the foreign exchange market will rapidly cascade into U.S. Treasury markets.
